description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mahaulpatha, Dimbulaga D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120005 (24/0535)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels (with parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) and declarations regarding land title settlements. The content is focused on land registration matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land titles, property ownership determinations, and land registration processes.
